summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC (the Company) filed a Form 6-K reporting multiple daily share repurchases conducted on the London Stock Exchange from May 15 through May 29, 2026. Under authority granted at the May 2025 AGM, Goldman Sachs International executed purchases of ordinary shares at average prices ranging from $148.07 to $150.65 per share. The Company intends to cancel all purchased shares. The filing, a UK-equivalent of a US issuer's share buyback disclosure, details total shares repurchased and resulting share count reduction. This is a routine capital return program, not a formal issuer tender offer under US rules. Watch for continued buyback execution and its impact on EPS and share count.
